verdict.rationale: Cekura has a broad programmatic surface: a published OpenAPI spec, API reference endpoints for ingesting calls and creating API keys, a CLI that manages agents, scenarios, runs and call data, sync/async SDKs, and an MCP/Skills plugin for AI assistants. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full API–UI parity. Some workflows are documented only through the UI, such as A/B comparison on the Results page and building dashboard widgets. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement or endpoint coverage for UI-only features (dashboards, A/B run comparison, PII redaction config), and independent or hands-on confirmation that the API covers the full UI.
